unassigned_nodes.node_id: אם נתעורר תכף ומיד ושב בתשובה
unassigned_nodes.reason: This node describes the human act of immediate repentance — awakening and returning in teshuvah before straying far. The only existing package (Package 1: תּוֹרָה וְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ) is built on the bechina identity of Torah = God = Mitzvot as the divine calling-presence. Immediate repentance is causally enabled BY hearing that calling voice, but it does not share its essential nature: repentance is a human response/action, not an aspect of the divine calling-presence itself. Per the framework, cause-and-effect flows between packages, not within them. This node belongs to the eitza chain (it is the cause-side of edge 422) and does not fit the bechina cluster of Package 1.

This node describes the outcome-state of easy return — the sinner can easily return to his original place. The only existing package (Package 1: תּוֹרָה וְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ) is built on the bechina identity of Torah = God = Mitzvot as the divine calling-presence. Easy return is the consequence produced by early repentance (itself enabled by still recognizing the calling voice), but it does not share the essential nature of the divine calling-presence. It is a state of the sinner, not an aspect of Torah/God/Mitzvot. Per the framework, cause-and-effect flows between packages, not within them. This node belongs to the eitza chain (it is the effect-side of edge 422) and does not fit the bechina cluster of Package 1.
